admission.justification: Records the by-design appendix row-151 closeout/rendering choices so future closeout work keeps them.

alternatives.option: Keep closeout-preview worklist and quality reports as closeout evidence and discard metadata-derived anchor hints. Permit generated-metadata-only differences when a card is rendered back; retain its how-to prose without inventing a behavior pin for that prose.
alternatives.reason: Conversion does not keep the metadata from which the hints were derived. Rendered-back differences are generated metadata, and retained how-to prose has no behavior to pin; neither supplies a new product-behavior test obligation.

alternatives.option: Admit metadata-derived anchor hints as closeout evidence or change the generated rendering contract.
alternatives.reason: Admitting derived hints would treat discarded metadata as evidence; changing the rendering contract to require a behavior pin would mistake generated metadata or nonbehavioral how-to prose for product behavior.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Appendix row 151 is revised to admit the hints or change rendering.

consequences: Future closeout work preserves the preview worklist/reports evidence and keeps metadata-derived anchor hints discarded.
Generated-metadata-only rendered differences do not create a byte-equality behavior requirement, and retained how-to prose does not acquire a behavior pin.
Future census and the duties moved to R63/R60 stay unchanged; this records the original row151 choice only.
context: MIK-R74 row151(part): retain the credited preview worklist/reports and discard metadata-derived anchor hints; a rendered-back card differs only in generated metadata and its retained how-to prose has no behavior to pin.
